world.h: Zelenskyy: no warning as Russia hits power grid
world.b: Zelenskyy said Ukraine got no early warning from partners as Russia struck its power grid again, and cited Starlink limits and a shortage of Patriot air defenses.

world.h: Iran war: Trump says US hitting Iran hard
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage: Trump says the US continues to hit Iran hard 'economically and militarily'.
world.title: Trump says US continues to hit Iran hard ‘economically and militarily’

national.h: Supreme Court to hear school admissions race case
national.b: The court will consider parents' claims of discrimination over admissions to four Montgomery County, Maryland, magnet schools after lower courts dismissed the case.
national.title: US Supreme Court to hear case on race in school admissions

national.h: Trump launches women's health division at NIH
national.b: Trump signed an order creating a women's health division at the NIH and the White House. Melania Trump called it a new standard for women's health.

national.h: Florida issues warrant for Raúl Castro
national.b: Florida's attorney general said the warrant stems from charges over Castro's alleged role in the 1996 shootdown of two Brothers to the Rescue aircraft.

national.h: Prosecutors: OpenAI bugging suspect had Saudi backing
national.b: US prosecutors say Abdulrahman Alfozan, accused of planting a device in an OpenAI conference room, was in frequent contact with a member of the Saudi royal family.

politics.b: A Reuters/Ipsos poll put Trump's approval at a record-low 31 percent, with Democrats leading a generic congressional ballot by 12 points.

politics.h: Schumer urges FCC to block AI robocalls
politics.b: Schumer asked the FCC to reject a Club for Growth petition to allow AI-generated robocalls before the midterms, warning campaigns could fake opponents' voices.

politics.h: Over two dozen charged in California voter sweep
politics.b: Federal authorities arrested more than two dozen foreign nationals in California, accusing them of illegally registering and voting, as the voter roll fight with the state escalates.

politics.h: Officials fear CISA weakened before midterms
politics.b: ProPublica reports election officials say Trump administration attacks on the cybersecurity agency CISA have left them to solve security issues on their own as the midterms approach.
politics.title: Trump Appointees Asked a Federal Cybersecurity Agency to Secretly Acquire a Voting Machine — and Hack It

politics.b: On Truth Social, Trump said he blocked sanctions on Russia to keep Moscow at the bargaining table, and accused Ukraine's Zelenskyy of not wanting to end the war.

international.b: About 76% of Alberta voters backed staying in Canada in a referendum that could have started a path to separation, a win for PM Mark Carney.
international.title: Alberta voters reject a move toward independence in referendum backing Canadian unity

international.h: Four dead as Storm Adam floods eastern Spain
international.b: Storm Adam dumped up to 700 litres of rain per square metre in 24 hours in parts of Valencia, isolating towns and prompting shelter orders for tens of thousands.
international.title: Four dead as torrential rain batters eastern Spain

international.h: Hegseth meets Netanyahu in unannounced visit
international.b: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met Netanyahu in Israel on Monday, Axios reported, as the Israeli leader faces a knife-edge election.
international.title: Hegseth meets Netanyahu in unannounced Israel visit

international.h: Exiled Kagame critic found beheaded in Uganda
international.b: Police said the body of Robert Kabera, a former Rwandan army sergeant who turned against President Kagame, was found in a village near Kampala.
More than 160 people were reported killed in western Sudan since Friday in drone attacks blamed on both the RSF and government forces.
international.title: 160 people reported killed in escalating drone attacks across Sudan

international.b: Gangs hit an armored vehicle with explosives in Port-au-Prince, and four Salvadoran soldiers are missing in the biggest attack since the international force began operations.

international.h: Kenyan cult leader convicted of murdering 191
international.b: A Mombasa court convicted pastor Paul Mackenzie and 28 associates over a doomsday sect whose followers starved themselves and their children in the Shakahola Forest.

international.h: Benny Gantz drops out of Israel’s election
international.b: Gantz said his Blue and White party will not run in the October 27 vote. Polls had shown it below the threshold to enter parliament.

international.h: Israel arrests 10 over West Bank settler attacks
international.b: Israeli police arrested 10 people after weekend settler attacks on a Washington Post photographer and European diplomats in the occupied West Bank.

international.h: French PM calls for city curfews after riots
international.b: PM Lecornu called for localized curfews in some cities to curb rioting and looting after weekend protests, saying it was a miracle no one was killed.

international.h: Australian MP Helen Haines hurt in car ramming
international.b: Independent MP Helen Haines, 65, was critically injured when an SUV struck her outside her office in Wangaratta. PM Albanese called it a deliberate act.

international.h: Houthi missiles kill at least 53 at Yemen camp
international.b: Houthi ballistic missiles struck a Yemeni government military camp in Shabwa during a training exercise, killing at least 53. The rebels acknowledged targeting the camp.

international.h: Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro trade insults in debate
international.b: Brazil's President Lula and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro called each other liars and traded corruption accusations in their first debate, a week before a tight presidential run-off.

business.h: Saudi Arabia cancels 'Davos in the Desert'
business.b: The Future Investment Initiative, set for Oct. 26-29, was called off amid deadly Houthi strikes on the kingdom, with a new date to be announced.
business.title: Saudi Arabia cancels 2026 ‘Davos in the Desert’ amid Houthi attacks

business.h: Shoppers uneasy as retailers adopt AI pricing
business.b: Consumer concerns are growing as retailers use AI-assisted pricing tools, with talk of surveillance pricing fueling worries that people pay different prices for the same product.

business.h: China's economy grows 4.5% in Q3, beating forecasts
business.b: China's GDP grew 4.5 percent in July-September from a year earlier, up from 4.3 percent in the second quarter and ahead of most analysts' forecasts, official figures showed.

business.h: Anthropic pledges 5% of shares to public fund
business.b: Anthropic, the maker of the AI assistant Claude, announced an Anthropic Public Benefit Fund with 5 percent of its shares, with plans to raise the contribution as its market value grows.

science.h: Japan launches mission to Mars moon Phobos
science.b: JAXA launched a spacecraft from Tanegashima to collect samples from Phobos, which no mission has visited. If it succeeds, samples arrive on Earth in 2031.
science.title: Japan launches spacecraft to Mars' moon in mission to bring back soil samples

science.h: Kelvin wave raised West Coast sea levels
science.b: An ocean Kelvin wave lifted sea levels along the West Coast, and more are coming. The waves can develop along the equator in El Niño years.

sports.h: Reese scores 30 as Dream even WNBA Finals
sports.b: Angel Reese had 30 points and 16 rebounds as Atlanta beat Golden State 79-65 in Game 2, tying the series 1-1.
sports.title: 'I need the ball': Inside what fueled Angel Reese to one of the best performances in WNBA Finals history

sports.h: Cardinals stun Rams 18-16 in season’s biggest upset
sports.b: Chad Ryland's 43-yard field goal as time expired gave 13.5-point underdog Arizona an 18-16 win, without scoring a touchdown. The Rams fall to 2-4.

sports.h: Ben Simmons tears Achilles before comeback
sports.b: Simmons, who signed a one-year deal with Sacramento last month after sitting out last season, was expected to start on opening night against the Clippers before the injury.

sports.h: Rodgers calls for NFL to examine Bucs' field
sports.b: Aaron Rodgers called the Tampa surface 'one of the worst playing surfaces in the league,' saying he has been injured on it twice before and player safety should come first.

sports.h: Browns take control of the AFC North
sports.b: Cleveland won its fourth game and now holds tiebreakers over two rivals atop the division, while the Giants fell 34-27 to the Saints amid quarterback and running back turmoil.

sports.h: Miami takes over No. 1 in AP poll, BYU to No. 2
sports.b: Miami is atop the AP poll for the first time since 2002 after the top teams all lost on the same day. Georgia slipped to No. 5 and Notre Dame fell to No. 4.

sports.h: Giants bench Winston, McCarthy rally falls short
sports.b: J.J. McCarthy threw for 243 yards and a touchdown in his first extensive action for the Giants, but his comeback bid came up short against the Saints.

sports.h: NFL, Saints address Paris game amid protests
sports.b: Safety concerns for players, staff and fans now dominate talk of next week's game in Paris, the first-ever regular-season NFL game in France, as protests escalate.

sports.h: Ole Miss earns an 'A' in commanding win
sports.b: Kewan Lacy ran for 122 yards and Trinidad Chambliss accounted for four touchdowns as Ole Miss improved to 5-1. Georgia got an 'F' after its loss to Auburn.

sports.h: Big 12 admits clock error in BYU-Notre Dame finish
sports.b: The Big 12 said Notre Dame should have had one second left for another play after CJ Carr's final heave fell incomplete and BYU fans stormed the field.

sports.h: BYU makes case for No. 1 after beating Notre Dame
sports.b: In a chaotic Week 7, No. 8 BYU beat No. 2 Notre Dame while No. 1 Georgia lost to unranked Auburn and Texas fell to unranked Florida, setting up a shake-up atop the rankings.

local.h: MTA train yards in disrepair, watchdog says
local.b: Plants grow through holes in the roof of the Bronx East 180th Street yard, where 2 and 5 trains are serviced, and water drips onto electrical equipment.
local.title: MTA train yards are in such bad shape plants are growing out of the roof, watchdog says

local.h: Hate crime charge in Queens bagel shop attack
local.b: Police charged a 22-year-old Fresh Meadows man with targeting Bagels & Co., a kosher shop on Union Turnpike, hurling dirt at its storefront and Israeli flags.
local.title: Queens man charged with hate crime at Jewish-owned bagel shop displaying Israeli flags

local.h: NYC team to help residents keep SNAP, Medicaid
local.b: Mayor Mamdani launched a Health and Affordability Resource Team of outreach workers to help New Yorkers keep benefits as federal eligibility rules change.
local.title: Mamdani launches new team to help NYers keep SNAP, Medicaid benefits

local.h: Ex-buildings chief Eric Ulrich goes on trial
local.b: Eric Ulrich, Eric Adams' former buildings commissioner, heads to trial three years after his arrest on charges of taking more than $150,000 in bribes.
local.title: Eric Adams' NYC buildings boss Eric Ulrich heads to trial, 3 years after arrest

local.h: NYC sues law firm over bogus trip-and-fall claims
local.b: The city's law department is going after Lower Manhattan firm Asher & Associates over lawsuits it says were fraudulent, including a $1 million sidewalk claim.
local.title: NYC sues personal injury law firm accused of bogus trip-and-fall claims

periods.name: Overnight
periods.text: Clear, with a low around 52. North wind around 11 mph.

periods.name: Tuesday
periods.text: Sunny, with a high near 68. North wind 13 to 15 mph.

periods.name: Tuesday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 52. North wind 13 to 15 mph.

periods.name: Wednesday
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 63. Northeast wind 13 to 15 mph.

periods.name: Wednesday Night
periods.text: Partly cloudy, with a low around 51. North wind 10 to 14 mph.

localgood.h: Free 2-K expands to the Bronx and Staten Island
localgood.b: Every school district in the Bronx and Staten Island will offer free preschool seats for 2-year-olds next fall, as the city adds 10,000 seats.
localgood.title: These are the NYC neighborhoods that will get free 2-K next fall

localgood.h: New NYC site helps find mental health care
localgood.b: NYC Mental Health Connect lists more than 600 behavioral health providers across the five boroughs, searchable by service, symptoms, age, location and insurance.
localgood.title: Need help with mental health or addiction services? NYC has a new tool.
